about_the_game:
Illuminate your curiosity and explore a different world...

Enter your personal journey of problem-solving, and explore the bounds of your ability in this isometric puzzle game that ascends in difficulty, yet comforts the mind. Successfully guide light from a spotlight to a mysterious orb, and adventure through biomes as you complete levels!

Try our free demo and leave feedback on Steam or by joining our community Discord!
